code: # A tuning table: three configurations, each on three folds under two seeds set.seed(1) cfgs <- data.frame(config_id = c("cfg_001", "cfg_002", "cfg_003"),                    skill = c(0.615, 0.62, 0.55), n_params = c(2e5, 2e6, 5e4)) cmp <- merge(expand.grid(config_id = cfgs$config_id, fold = 1:3, seed = 1:2,                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE), cfgs) cmp$status  <- "success" cmp$val_ccc <- cmp$skill + rnorm(nrow(cmp), 0, 0.02) summarise_resamples(cmp, metrics = "val_ccc") #> # A tibble: 3 × 10 #>   config_id n_units n_folds n_seeds val_ccc_mean val_ccc_sd n_params val_ccc_se #>   <chr>       <int>   <int>   <int>        <dbl>      <dbl>    <dbl>      <dbl> #> 1 cfg_002         6       3       2        0.631     0.0117  2000000    0.00479 #> 2 cfg_001         6       3       2        0.614     0.0189   200000    0.00770 #> 3 cfg_003         6       3       2        0.547     0.0242    50000    0.00989 #> # ℹ 2 more variables: n_failed <int>, rank <int>
